bio.text: Jason Belton of Blythewood is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina secretary of state in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Mark Hammond.
He defeated Edwina Winter in the June 2026 Democratic primary.
He is vice president of the Greater Columbia Central Labor Council, which works with the AFL-CIO to represent the interests of local unions.
